sections.label: EFFECT
sections.html: Lock is source-linked: a particular Ballistics user maintains Lock on a particular target. It identifies that target for the owner's Ballistics effects but provides no universal numerical bonus by itself. Several characters can independently Lock the same creature.

sections.label: LOSS
sections.html: Lock ends when its owner replaces or consumes it, a rule explicitly ends it, the Encounter ends, or the owner has lost sufficient detection to target the creature and has not restored it by the end of their Turn. Applicable special Senses count as detection; line of sight is not required. Lock itself neither detects nor reveals a target and does not waive any attack's targeting requirements.

sections.label: REMOVAL
sections.html: Effects that remove ordinary Conditions do not remove Specialty Conditions unless they explicitly say so.
